facts.statement: Free Realms released newer TV commercials, presented as a holiday TV spot, and linked the video from the official news page.
facts.quote: Did you see our newest Free Realms commercials on TV yet? Check out the latest video right here!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Free Realms Holiday TV Spot)
article_summaries.summary: A short official freerealms.com news post announcing new Free Realms commercials on TV, framed as a holiday TV spot, with a link to the video. It has no gameplay, quest, item or mechanics details. The exact post date is not in the text; the page shows only 'Posted 1 year, 1 month ago' relative to the 2011-02-08 capture.
